comment: Curated in-scope authors for the marxists.org ingest. kind: marxist = Writers' Library archive, reference = Reference Archive. Paths are site-relative (www.marxists.org canonical; crawl via mirror). guidance steers the per-author work selection: philosophical / economic / sociological works only — books, major essays, lecture series; never letters, speeches, party resolutions, news journalism. skip_titles = already in the Falsafa corpus.

authors.name: Karl Marx & Frederick Engels
authors.guidance: The joint Marx/Engels archive. Major works of both authors: Capital I-III, Theories of Surplus Value, Grundrisse, Critique of Political Economy, 1844 Manuscripts, German Ideology, Poverty of Philosophy, Wage Labour and Capital, Value Price and Profit, 18th Brumaire, Civil War in France, Class Struggles in France, Critique of the Gotha Programme, Theses on Feuerbach, Holy Family; Engels: Anti-Duhring, Dialectics of Nature, Origin of the Family, Condition of the Working Class, Socialism Utopian and Scientific, Ludwig Feuerbach, Peasant War in Germany, Housing Question. Attribute each work to 'Karl Marx', 'Frederick Engels', or 'Karl Marx & Frederick Engels' as the work's own title page does.

authors.name: Vladimir Lenin
authors.guidance: Major philosophical/economic/social-theory books and long essays only (roughly 12-20 works): Development of Capitalism in Russia, What Is To Be Done?, Materialism and Empirio-criticism, Philosophical Notebooks, Imperialism the Highest Stage, State and Revolution, Left-Wing Communism, The State (lecture), Karl Marx (encyclopedia article), Three Sources and Three Component Parts, On Cooperation, The Tax in Kind, Economics and Politics in the Era of the Dictatorship. NOT the thousands of articles, speeches, telegrams.

authors.name: Leon Trotsky
authors.guidance: Major theoretical books only: Results and Prospects, Permanent Revolution, Literature and Revolution, Problems of Everyday Life, Their Morals and Ours, In Defense of Marxism, The Revolution Betrayed, Terrorism and Communism, History of the Russian Revolution (counts: history/social theory), My Life, Lessons of October, The New Course. NOT articles, letters, military writings.

authors.name: Karl Kautsky
authors.guidance: Theoretical books: The Class Struggle (Erfurt Program), Ethics and the Materialist Conception of History, The Economic Doctrines of Karl Marx, Foundations of Christianity, Origin of Christianity, Thomas More and his Utopia, The Agrarian Question, The Social Revolution, The Road to Power, Dictatorship of the Proletariat, Terrorism and Communism, Communism in Central Europe in the Time of the Reformation, The Materialist Conception of History, High Cost of Living.

authors.name: Rosa Luxemburg
authors.guidance: Theoretical works: The Accumulation of Capital, Anti-Critique, Reform or Revolution, The Mass Strike, The Industrial Development of Poland, Introduction to Political Economy, The National Question, Organizational Questions of Russian Social Democracy, The Russian Revolution, The Junius Pamphlet, What is Economics?

authors.name: Georgi Plekhanov
authors.guidance: All his philosophical works: Development of the Monist View of History, The Role of the Individual in History, Essays on the History of Materialism, Fundamental Problems of Marxism, Materialismus Militans, Art and Social Life, Anarchism and Socialism, On the Materialist Understanding of History, Socialism and the Political Struggle, Our Differences.

authors.name: Josef Stalin
authors.guidance: Theoretical works only: Dialectical and Historical Materialism, Anarchism or Socialism, Marxism and the National Question, Foundations of Leninism, Problems of Leninism, Marxism and Problems of Linguistics, Economic Problems of Socialism in the USSR. NOT speeches, congress reports, orders.

authors.name: Mao Zedong
authors.guidance: Philosophical essays only: On Practice, On Contradiction, On the Correct Handling of Contradictions Among the People, Where Do Correct Ideas Come From?, Oppose Book Worship, On New Democracy, Talks at the Yenan Forum on Literature and Art. NOT military writings, directives, speeches.

authors.name: Antonio Gramsci
authors.guidance: The archive states remaining texts are CC BY-SA translations made for marxists.org (Camilleri, Abidor, Campbell, Carley). Take the theoretical/cultural essays and any prison-notebook material present; record the per-text translator. Capture the archive-level CC notice verbatim as license evidence for every work.

authors.name: Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel
authors.guidance: The 'Hegel by HyperText' library. Whole works in old public-domain translations: Phenomenology of Mind (Baillie 1910), Science of Logic (Johnston & Struthers 1929), Shorter Logic (Wallace 1873), Philosophy of Right (Dyde 1896), Philosophy of History (Sibree 1857), Philosophy of Mind (Wallace 1894), History of Philosophy (Haldane 1892), Philosophy of Nature if present, Philosophical Propaedeutic. Note the translator + translation year for each; skip modern commentary by other authors.

authors.name: (Classics of Political Economy index)
authors.guidance: This is a subject hub, not one author. Enumerate hosted full texts by economists NOT covered elsewhere and NOT already in the corpus (corpus already holds Smith, Ricardo, Malthus, J.S. Mill, Bentham core titles). Look for Petty, Quesnay, Turgot, Senior-type classics hosted ON marxists.org (not external links). Return each as its own work row with its real author.
